addressed.claim_id: Fixed _check_digits to always return exactly two digits with leading zero padding using f"{98 - remainder:02d}" as required by Rules 3 and 4 (e.g. base "7" now correctly yields "09" and "RF097" with length 5).

This also fixes the second validation check in is_valid_rf_reference which re-uses _check_digits; valid references with check digits "00".."09" such as "RF097" are now accepted and both checksum conditions agree per Rules 7 and 8.
